There is no Replay ctor for bdBoolResult. The builder size 72 and its prior-only layout (base 16 + base 16 + m_result at 48) are not supported by Replay: the Replay object is at MatchmakingData+8 and must end by +64. Game-test's m_result at +32 gives a 33-byte minimum if it is proven, but the bytes from +33 to +56 have no Replay proof either way. The tail-closure rule does not give a size: the game-test last member m_result (+32, 1 byte) closes at +33, aligned to 8 that is 40, but nothing proves the object has no Replay-used bytes at +33..+56, and game-test's size 56 is unexplained by its listed fields. The coordinator should leave the IDA layout (56) in place: it agrees with the parent bound; do not change the size or move m_result without the bd completion writer.
